name: Bubble Gaze Cursor
summary: A gaze-based area cursor technique that applies the bubble cursor mechanism to eye-gaze interaction, enlarging the effective selection area around the gaze point.
howItWorks: The user looks toward the desired target. The system places a bubble-like area cursor around the gaze position and selects the nearest or most likely target inside the adaptive selection area.
advantages: Selecting small or closely spaced targets with eye gaze when direct gaze pointing is difficult due to eye-tracking noise or limited gaze precision.
limitations: The technique can still become ambiguous when multiple targets are close to the gaze point, and gaze jitter may affect which object is treated as the nearest candidate.
